en: Black‑and‑white illustrated skiing-themed postcard or poster showing a slalom skier racing downhill between flags in a mountainous winter landscape. Large hand‑drawn text at the top announces a slalom event in 1941. The word "Kiruna" and the date "25 Mars" (25 March) appear on the left. At the bottom is Swedish text naming the organizer, Kiruna Bollklubb, alongside the club's circular KBK logo. A small handwritten signature with the year 1940 appears in the lower right.
